decision_context.selection_rationale: A unified error contract is required for both internal and public consumers across HTTP APIs.
decision_context.naming_convention_summary: Error codes are namespaced machine-readable identifiers and are stable across versions.
decision_context.threshold_method_summary: Timeout and retry/error thresholds are derived from dependency SLA and incident recovery objectives.

threshold_policy.latency_target_derivation: Error-path latency targets are derived from normal-path SLO and incident triage expectations.
threshold_policy.availability_target_derivation: Availability targets align with service criticality and client impact class.
threshold_policy.timeout_budget_derivation: Timeout budgets are split across upstream dependency boundaries to preserve fail-fast behavior.
threshold_policy.capacity_headroom_derivation: Headroom accounts for incident-time retry storms and degraded dependency behavior.
threshold_policy.payload_limit_derivation: Error payload size limits prevent sensitive leakage and logging overhead.
threshold_policy.concurrency_limit_derivation: Concurrency limits use thread-pool and connection-pool saturation analysis.
threshold_policy.retry_backoff_derivation: Retry/backoff policy is tied to retryable error categories and idempotency constraints.
threshold_policy.delivery_semantics_derivation: Error responses define deterministic client action semantics for retry, abort, or user correction.
